name: layer
description: Everything that shows in Layers. The order among siblings is the drawing order: the last one is drawn on top. A layer has a transform of its own (x, y, rotation, scaleX, scaleY around its origin) that moves, turns and scales everything inside it without changing the vertices; a group's transform applies to the layers in it.

visible.description: If false, neither the layer nor its children are drawn.
visible.help: When off, the layer and its children are not drawn.

locked.description: Editor lock: the layer and its children can't be picked or changed on the canvas. It does not change how it looks. It is the user's: the AI does not change a locked layer or its children unless asked, and does not unlock it.
locked.help: Locked layers can't be picked or changed on the canvas.

x.description: Moves the layer and everything in it right (px, in its parent's coordinates), without changing its parts' vertices: Moho's Transform Layer.
x.help: Moves the layer right, without changing its drawing.

y.description: Moves the layer and everything in it down (px, in its parent's coordinates), without changing its parts' vertices.
y.help: Moves the layer down, without changing its drawing.

rotation.description: Turns the layer and everything in it around its origin, in degrees (clockwise), without changing its parts' vertices.
rotation.help: Turns the layer around its origin (degrees).

scaleX.description: Scales the layer and everything in it horizontally around its origin (1 = as drawn; negative flips it), without changing its parts' vertices.
scaleX.help: Horizontal scale around the origin (1 = as drawn).

scaleY.description: Scales the layer and everything in it vertically around its origin (1 = as drawn; negative flips it), without changing its parts' vertices.
scaleY.help: Vertical scale around the origin (1 = as drawn).

originX.description: X of the origin: the point the layer turns and scales around, in the layer's own coordinates. null = the center of its content. A transformed layer always gets one (where it turns), so adding content does not move it; changing the origin of a transformed layer moves its x, y too, so the layer stays where it is.
originX.help: Origin X: the point it rotates and scales around. Empty = its center.

originY.description: Y of the origin: the point the layer turns and scales around, in the layer's own coordinates. null = the center of its content. A transformed layer always gets one (where it turns), so adding content does not move it; changing the origin of a transformed layer moves its x, y too, so the layer stays where it is.
originY.help: Origin Y: the point it rotates and scales around. Empty = its center.
